description: This file defines the LDAPTestSyncService class, which extends LDAPSyncService, for testing LDAP synchronization in the OrangeHRM system. It handles creation and configuration of LDAPTestService instances, including handling bind credentials based on LDAP settings.

classes.name: LDAPTestSyncService
classes.description: A service class extending LDAPSyncService to facilitate LDAP testing with specific settings, including initializing LDAPTestService and handling bind credentials.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Returns an LDAPService instance, creating and binding LDAPTestService if not already initialized.
